consumer: The mission/dialogue completion check that asks 'does the player have the fetch part needed to return to the contact?' — the condition consumed by the mission-objective/dialogue eligibility evaluation.
scope: The fetch-mission required reach: the part counts as 'got' over the reachable inventory the objective recognizes (carried plus nearby/adjacent/vehicle-cargo reach), not strictly on-person.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — builds the u_has_items/npc_has_items lambda returning actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over d.alpha/d.beta, an on-person possession test only.
divergence: Player stands adjacent to (or in) a vehicle whose cargo trunk holds the mission part; a fetch objective over reachable inventory reports the part obtained, but u_has_items (on-person has_charges/has_amount) returns false, so the proposal wrongly says the mission is incomplete.
